faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Clear answers to the most common questions from restaurant and cafe owners
faqs.q1: Do customers need to download an app to open the menu?
faqs.a1: Not at all! Customers simply scan the QR code with their phone camera and the interactive menu opens instantly in the browser.
faqs.a2: Orders can be received directly on WhatsApp with full customization details, or tracked through the live cashier and KDS screen.
faqs.q3: Can I update prices and items myself?
faqs.a3: Yes, easily! Through a simple dashboard from your phone or computer, you can update prices, add new items, or hide sold-out dishes in seconds.
faqs.q4: Do you charge any commission on sales or orders?
faqs.a4: No, MenuJet charges 0% commission on your orders. You keep 100% of your earnings with zero hidden fees.

privacy_page.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_page.subtitle: At MenuJet, we are committed to protecting your privacy and your customers' data with the highest security standards.
privacy_page.sec1_p1: This Privacy Policy governs how MenuJet ("the Platform", "we", or "us") collects, uses, maintains, and protects information from users (restaurant owners, food businesses, and customers browsing digital menus).
privacy_page.sec1_p2: By using MenuJet, scanning a QR Code, or browsing hosted menus, you consent to the practices described in this document.
privacy_page.sec2_a_desc: Name, email address, phone number, restaurant name, logo, menu items, pricing, and social media links.
privacy_page.sec2_b_desc: Customer phone number (for WhatsApp orders), delivery address, table or queue number, and order notes. We do not store sensitive bank card data.
privacy_page.sec2_c_desc: Device and browser type, approximate IP address, visit timestamps, and menu interactions to optimize performance and generate analytics.
privacy_page.sec3_item1: Operating and maintaining digital menus and generating QR codes.
privacy_page.sec3_item2: Facilitating seamless order transmission between customers and restaurants via WhatsApp or Cashier.
privacy_page.sec3_item3: Providing sales analytics and performance insights to help restaurant owners grow.
privacy_page.sec3_item4: Communicating system updates, billing notifications, and providing technical support.
privacy_page.sec3_item5: Preventing fraudulent activities and securing the platform against unauthorized use.
privacy_page.sec4_desc: We never sell or rent personal information to third parties for marketing. Data is only shared with trusted service providers strictly to operate our service:
privacy_page.sec4_item1: Secure cloud database providers (Supabase / Cloud Infrastructure) with state-of-the-art encryption.
privacy_page.sec4_item2: Certified payment gateways for secure subscription processing.
privacy_page.sec4_item3: WhatsApp services for directing customer orders to designated merchant phone numbers.
privacy_page.sec5_desc: We implement rigorous technical and organizational safeguards including HTTPS/SSL transit encryption and Row Level Security (RLS) to ensure merchants only access their own private data.
privacy_page.sec6_desc: Merchants retain the right to edit details, update menus, export order history, or request full account and data deletion at any time by contacting support.
privacy_page.sec7_desc: If you have any questions or inquiries regarding our Privacy Policy or data handling, please contact us via WhatsApp or our official email.

faq_page.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq_page.subtitle: Everything you need to know about setting up your digital menu, printing QR codes, and managing orders with MenuJet.
faq_page.empty_desc: Try different keywords or contact our support team directly.
faq_page.banner_desc: Our support team is available to assist you step-by-step with menu customization and setup.
faq_page.q1_q: What is MenuJet and how does it benefit my restaurant?
faq_page.q1_a: MenuJet is an all-in-one system transforming traditional paper menus into fast, smart digital menus accessible via QR scan on any smartphone without installing apps. It saves recurring printing costs, allows instant menu and price updates, and facilitates orders with 0% commission.
faq_page.q2_q: Do my customers need to download an app to view the menu?
faq_page.q2_a: Not at all. Customers simply point their smartphone camera at the QR code on the table, and the menu opens instantly in their browser with high performance and responsive design.
faq_page.q3_q: How do I add items and update prices?
faq_page.q3_a: Through a user-friendly dashboard, you can create categories, upload item images, and set single or tiered prices (e.g., small, medium, large, or weight-based). Any updates saved are reflected instantly on customer screens.
faq_page.q4_q: What if an item runs out of stock during service?
faq_page.q4_a: With a single click from your dashboard, you can mark the item as "Out of Stock". It will immediately be displayed as unavailable, preventing orders until you re-enable it.
faq_page.q5_q: How do I obtain and print my QR code?
faq_page.q5_a: MenuJet provides an integrated "QR Print Studio" in your dashboard. With one click, customize stands with your logo, name, and promotional hooks, ready to print as compact table stands or wall posters in high resolution.
faq_page.q6_q: How does the restaurant receive customer orders?
faq_page.q6_a:
The platform supports two convenient channels:
1. Direct WhatsApp messaging formatted with item details, total price, table/queue number, address, and payment method.
2. Direct reception via the Cashier Orders dashboard with real-time sound and vibration alerts.
faq_page.q7_q: Can customers edit their order after submitting?
faq_page.q7_a: Yes, MenuJet features a smart grace window (configurable, e.g., 3 to 10 minutes) allowing customers to edit or cancel their order before kitchen preparation commences.
faq_page.q8_q: Does MenuJet charge commissions on orders or sales?
faq_page.q8_a: MenuJet charges absolutely zero commission (0%). You only pay a flat monthly or annual subscription fee, retaining 100% of your sales revenues.
faq_page.q9_q: Can I test the platform for free before paying?
faq_page.q9_a: Yes, we provide a 14-day full-featured free trial. Additionally, our support team can assist you in inputting your initial menu free of charge.
faq_page.q10_q: What payment methods are supported for subscriptions?
faq_page.q10_a: We accept credit/debit cards (Visa, MasterCard), mobile wallets (Vodafone Cash, Orange, Etisalat, WE Pay), and InstaPay instant transfers.
